mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (user_id, title, content, original_thumbnail_image, hashed_thumbnail_image, original_banner_image, hashed_banner_image, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{originalThumbnailImage}, #{hashedThumbnailImage}, #{originalBannerImage}, #{hashedBannerImage}, NOW(), NOW());
mapper.select:
SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeid, n.user_id AS userId, u.username, n.title, n.content, n.original_thumbnail_image AS originalThumbnailImage, n.hashed_thumbnail_image AS hashedThumbnailImage, n.original_banner_image AS originalBannerImage, n.hashed_banner_image AS hashedBannerImage, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.updated_at, n.view_count AS views_count FROM notice n JOIN users u ON n.user_id = u.id
AND n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{end}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice n
AND n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeid, n.title, n.content, n.view_count AS views_count, -- DTO랑 같아야하는데 틀렸음.. n.original_banner_image AS originalBannerImage, -- 배너 이미지 원본 파일명 n.hashed_banner_image AS hashedBannerImage, -- 해싱된 배너 이미지 파일명 n.created_at AS createdAt, u.username -- 유저명 FROM notice n JOIN Users u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.notice_id = #{id}
